name: Post-campaign museum and excavation sweep
strategy: Independent multilingual museum-accession and excavation-context search across institutional catalogues, project pages, recent excavation syntheses, and NLI collection reporting.
notes: Did not qualify because 14/1332 = 1.051%, just above the threshold. Additions included seven item-level museum/excavation records and seven conservatively split Klagsbald donation components that may later deduplicate against NLI SRU records.

name: Current-scholarship and first-edition sweep
strategy: Independent 2023–2026 DOI, journal, repository, author-profile, first-edition, and previously-unpublished phrase search in English and Hebrew, followed by exact object-identifier comparison.
notes: Qualified: 3/1346 = 0.223%. Added Christie’s 1974 lot 348, BM 117877, and the Davidovitz popularity bowl. The 41-object Syriac Manichaean working list was checked and already represented.

name: Auction and dealer market sweep
strategy: Independent broad and exact-phrase sweep of auction houses, aggregators, dealers, historical results, current listings, group lots, dimensions, provenance phrases, and pseudo-script vocabulary.
notes: Qualified: 8/1349 = 0.593%. Added six single-object market records and split a two-bowl TimeLine group lot; known Stahl, Potomack, Kedem, Bonhams, and Madhloom-chain records were recognized rather than re-added.
